system.description: Hackers get all the glory, but you're the one who actually gets things done. Cyberdeck took a couple of pellets from that security team? Call the Tech. Need a bus wired to blow? Call the Tech. Need to lay twenty-two klicks of hardline from the grid to your desert hide? Call the effin' Tech. At least the jobs pay better than crawling around ductwork in a Sprawl tenement.
